scientific_question: Does evidence-conditioned, gap-guided atomic question induction recover substantially more teacher evidence than one-shot source-aware Qwen or a fixed checklist, without teacher leakage or any retriever/model-family change?

research_basis.lesson: Generate questions from passages/documents rather than rely on a single incoming query.
Useful decomposition is possible, but comprehensive subquestion coverage is difficult without supporting evidence.

research_basis.source: Iterative decomposition/retrieval systems (UniRAG, Hi-Q, S2G-RAG, FIRE)
research_basis.lesson: Interleave decomposition with evidence inspection or explicit missing-information/gap checks instead of committing to one static question set.

teacher_anti_leak_audit.purpose: Teacher-only post-generation audit; never shown to generator.
teacher_anti_leak_audit.numeric_token_policy: Any generated query containing a digit is rejected before retrieval.
teacher_anti_leak_audit.source_copy_policy: Reject a generated query if it copies a contiguous >=9-token sequence from source context.

retrieval.candidate_pool: Same exact propositions on pages reached by existing top-12 FACET_INTERLEAVED_BM25_V1 coarse region route.

WAVE7A2_PROMISING: Candidate with BM25 or BGE hybrid supports >=10/13 teacher atoms in fused top-24.
Candidate recovers all three historical misses e2.a/e2.b/e4.b.
Candidate nine-paper merged page recall >=90% of coarse selected-page recall ceiling.
Candidate improves teacher supported atoms by >=3 over the matching one-shot source-aware Wave 7A control.
WAVE7A2_PARTIAL: No candidate pair meets PROMISING, but candidate supports >=8/13 teacher atoms OR recovers all three historical misses.
No hard provenance or anti-leak boundary fails.
WAVE7A2_REJECT: Candidate meets neither PROMISING nor PARTIAL, or a hard safety boundary fails.
